label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 141
title: Dashboard: run a backlog item (scoped amend run) + surface the quality gate (block on failure)
body:
## Problem / why
Executing a BACKLOG ITEM should be the flow that enforces quality (the item is a real change),
whereas a full e2e pipeline run does not need the repo audits. Today the dashboard cannot start an
item-scoped run nor show whether the quality gate passed.

## Goal & value
From a backlog item, trigger a scoped (amend) run and surface the backend quality-gate result;
block applying the change when the gate fails (policy).

## In scope
- "Run item" action on a backlog item -> backend scoped (amend) run for the item's affected
  stages/agents (run_scope).
- Show the quality-gate result (pass/fail + reasons) on the item/run; block/confirm on failure.

## Out of scope
- e2e pipeline run UI (no repo-audit gate there). Backend gate logic (backend item).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Running an item shows the quality gate result and, on failure, does not mark the item complete.
- A planned-feature/e2e run is not gated by the repo audits.

## Dependencies & links
- Consumes backend: run-mode quality gate (backend item), run_scope (amend runs), BI-0167 amend mode.

## Verification / test plan
- Item run with a failing gate -> UI shows failure + blocks; passing gate -> item can proceed.
